nodes.name: Co-precipitation of Co(OH)2
nodes.procedure: CoCl2·6H2O (2 mmol), NaCl (10 mmol), and hexamethylenetetramine (12 mmol) were dissolved in a mixture of deionized water (200 mL) and ethanol (20 mL). The solution was magnetically stirred at 90 oC for 2 h, and cooled down to room temperature. The as-obtained products were washed three times with deionized water and ethanol. The final products were dried at 40 oC under vacuum overnight.

nodes.name: In-situ Growth and Selenization on Ni Foam
nodes.procedure: CoCl2·6H2O (1.6 mmol), FeCl3 (0.4 mmol), NaCl (10 mmol), and hexamethylenetetramine (12 mmol) were dissolved in a mixture of deionized water (200 mL) and ethanol (20 mL). Then, acid-treated Ni foam (1 cm × 2 cm) was added. Cobalt-iron hydroxides were in-situ grown on Ni foam under magnetic stirring at 90 oC for 2 h. Then, the cobalt-iron hydroxides@Ni foam was transferred into a 50-mL autoclave containing a mixture of Se (3.75 mmol), NaOH (7.5 mmol), hydrazine (0.14 mL), and DMF (25 mL). The autoclave was kept at 180 oC for 1 h and then cooled down to room temperature. The final product was washed with ethanol for three times and dried.

nodes.name: Cathodic Electrochemical Deposition
nodes.procedure: Supports were mixed with equal weight active carbon and loaded onto a glassy carbon electrode by Nafion. The electrolyte contains 100 μM metal precursors (IrCl4·xH2O) and 1 M KOH. The electrochemical depositions were carried out from 0.10 V to -0.40 V with a sweeping rate of 5 mV/s. The process was repeated for ten times. After the depositions, the electrode was washed with deionized water.

nodes.procedure: 0.04g of MnCl2·4H2O was dissolved in 10 mL of ethanolamine under vigorous stirring at room temperature, followed by adding 10 mL of deionized water. nodes.name: Synthesis of MoS2 nanosheets
nodes.procedure: (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O (1 mmol) and thiourea (30 mmol) were dissolved in deionized water (35 mL) under vigorous stirring. Then, the solution was transferred into a 45-mL Teflon-lined stainless steel autoclave and maintained at 220 oC. After 18 h, the reaction system was allowed to cool down to room temperature. The final products were washed with deionized water and ethanol for several times and dried at 40 oC under vacuum overnight.

nodes.name: Synthesis of N-C
nodes.procedure: Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (1.68 g) was dissolved in 80 mL of methanol. A mixture of 2-methylimidazole (3.70 g) and methanol (80 mL) was added under vigorous stirring for 24 h. Products were washed and dried at 50 oC under vacuum overnight. Powder was activated at 200 oC under vacuum for 24 h. Then 500 mg of activated powder was heated to 900 oC with a heating rate of 5 oC/min and carbonized at 900 oC under N2 atmosphere for 2 h.
